scope: source inspection only; no full graph construction, compiler, sampler, or forecast
supported: The proposed derivative order matches pinned PyMC Model.dlogp: model.logp(jacobian=True), rewrite_pregrad(cost), then gradient(cost, continuous_value_vars). The helper ravels each variable and concatenates in input order. This is an exact source-level API-path match, conditional on pinned code remaining unchanged.

The proposal replaces the exact typed exposure node in the complete logp before rewrite/gradient, checks preservation of original value inputs, requires E as an input after each stage, disallows the old node, and constrains exposure to shape (3,24) and positive finite values.

First-parent mass/target contract and component inventory are checked and persisted; parent mass is asserted unused in logp. Shape witness, name set, 662 total coordinates, and native variable ordering are compared. This is a first-parent-specific derivation; it does not authenticate arbitrary later-parent labels or prove normalized all-parent inference.

Resource gates are meaningful if executed through launch_once: child hard CPU/address-space/file caps, parent watchdog, one-thread backend environment, fresh packet-local cache/output and output/RSS/wall watchdog. No operational test or resource receipt currently exists.

corrections_and_gaps.finding: The receipt is caller-selected metadata verified by its supplied SHA, not an independent approval/authentication system. A caller able to create and pass the receipt can authorize the graph build. Keep the README's trusted-caller caveat; do not describe this as cryptographic scientific authorization or an automatic user-permission gate.

The stale-exposure scan catches equal (3,24) constants matching any selected parent, but cannot establish that all exposure influence flows through E, nor rule out transformed/stale constants or semantically wrong candidate/row wiring. It is a useful tripwire only; inspect graph lineage and later numerical dependence separately.

The code records a symbolic graph pickle without a schema/runtime restore test. Hash it and treat as untrusted; do not load it before verifying all source/runtime pins. Serialization failure is correctly retained as failure.

A killed process may leave partial output without failure.log, but launch_once is designed to preserve process.log and terminal.json; these files must be checked together and partial attempt must never be reused. Polling-based RSS/disk caps can overshoot by one 250 ms interval.

parent_and_target_envelope: Source shows selection and first parent are pinned through the provider/selection inputs; p.validate(problem,parent,selection), parent identity digest, mass, population_cut_v1, scientific target digest, factor inventory and coordinate witness are checked. This is adequate for the specific frozen first-parent hypothesis as written, but no generalized full-parent envelope API is implemented and no inference over other parent masses is established.
native_equivalence: Source-level derivative construction is equivalent to PyMC Model.dlogp path. A separate explicit call to model.dlogp is not made, but its exact body was inspected and the same pinned rewrite_pregrad/gradient helpers are called. This supports implementation-path equivalence, not numerical parity or symbolic pass.
failure_preservation: Stage receipts are atomically replaced at each successful checkpoint and exception handling writes traceback and a failed stage. Abrupt kill/power loss can interrupt a stage; launcher terminal receipt is therefore mandatory. No original project outputs are targeted by the launcher.
recommendation: The symbolic-only experiment is technically reviewable within the planned narrow scope after an explicit caller-selected receipt and fresh resource observation. Maintain one attempt, inspect terminal and every stage, preserve any failure, and do not proceed to numerical compilation/sampling without a new scope.
